## What you did
- You rehearsed the PG17 cutover on a production snapshot clone: writes were unavailable for 74 seconds, the API reconnected without restarts, and row counts matched on the 20 largest tables. You’ve since torn down the clone. [1]

## What changed
- Daniel Levi will cover the API on Sunday and asked you to ping him at switchover. Lior Ben-David needs 30 minutes’ notice to pause ingest consumers; the workers need no configuration changes. [7][9]

## What is still open
- **The production cutover moved to Sunday 22 November, 02:00–04:00 UTC** to avoid Fernhill’s batch. Maya Cohen approved #321 and confirmed it can now merge; the runbook still needs the new window. Your Terraform plan preserves the dashboards read replica, with zero destroys. [1][3][8]
- The rollback rehearsal is still due Thursday 19 November on a fresh clone. You want to measure recovery time and data loss: the old primary stops receiving writes after switchover, so rollback isn’t a simple switch back. [1]
